name: Your Dream Remodeling

gbp_reviews_visible.text: Your Dream Remodeling did an outstanding job renovating two of our bathrooms. From planning, design and costing with Garrett to the actual remodeling with Jose, Hugo and Ike. All of them were friendly, professional and communicative. I have no hesitation in recommending them very strongly.

The Your Dream Remodeling team did an excellent job in remodeling my bathroom. They met all the time lines and most importantly the price was very reasonable. The final product was beyond my expectations. Again thank you for an outstanding job.

Your Dream Remodeling completed a full master bath remodeling by converting our standing shower and Jacuzzi tub to a zero curb  walk-in shower. They installed custom cabinets and new flooring throughout as well as a custom closet.  The project was completed within the estimated time and we are very pleased with the result.
